response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks demonstrated professional C++ development on Windows in capital markets or fixed income domains — the core requirements. Their C++ exposure is limited to academic/bachelor's thesis work and non-financial embedded systems, with no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle, fixed income products, or investment banking systems. Their recent work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no indication of Windows-specific C++ development in finance.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical leadership
Extensive DevOps and CI/CD exposure across multiple environments
concerns: No professional C++ experience on Windows in financial domain
Lacks demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise in capital markets context
Fixed income or investment banking domain knowledge not evidenced
